description.value: The Canso Bomber Crash Site preserves the remarkably intact wreckage of RCAF Canso 11007, a WWII-era flying boat that crashed on a hillside shortly after takeoff on February 12, 1945. The 5km return trail from Radar Hill passes through a notoriously muddy bog, a creepy abandoned wartime building, and a bomb-crater pond before reaching the fuselage, which visitors can climb into and inspect. It is one of the most unusual and historically evocative hikes on the west coast of Vancouver Island.

The guide confirms the site is accessible to the public and describes a lower parking lot at Radar Hill as the trailhead, but mentions no bike-specific infrastructure, washrooms, or water sources anywhere along the route. All amenity fields default to null as neither OSM tags nor the website provide any evidence of cyclist facilities.
